wants.topic: Festival-Specific Vrat Kathas with Puja Vidhi
wants.evidence: FaKT Dharmik Katha's Karwa Chauth and Bhai Dooj videos significantly outperformed their channel median.
GK Hindi Stories and Mooli Toons TV see high engagement when mixing mythological elements with emotional/poverty-to-prosperity tropes.

gaps: Authentic visual recreations of ancient Vedic era settings (most channels rely on stock or low-quality animation)
Detailed 'scientific' or historical explanation of why specific rituals were performed in ancient India
Interactive Q&A sessions addressing specific doubts about Vrat rules (many viewers ask about 'niyam' and 'vidhi' in comments)
saturated: Generic 'Hanuman Chalisa' or 'Tuesday Vrat Katha' videos
Standard Ekadashi Vrat Kathas (these are currently underperforming across multiple channels)
Short-form 'Tulsi Vivah' or 'Sharad Purnima' clips that lack depth
title_patterns: Time-based nostalgia: '100 साल पहले [Festival] कैसी होती थी?'
Urgency/Fear-of-Missing-Out: 'संतान सुख के लिए जरूर सुनें' or 'रातों रात बदल गई किस्मत'
Controversial/Mystery hooks: 'आखिर पत्नी ने ऐसा क्या किया?' or 'तूफानी रात में गरीब चरवाहे को अपने घर क्यों बुलाया'
